_about: The repository settings this project expects, with the reason for each. The weekly self-routines compare GitHub against this file and report any drift in the health issue. They never change a setting: only an owner does, in Settings. Reviewed 2 November 2026; see docs/repo-settings.md.

has_wiki: Docs live in the repository (docs/), reviewed through pull requests
has_issues: Corrections and defects come in as issues
web_commit_signoff_required: Every web edit carries the author's sign-off
allow_squash_merge: The GDS Way asks for commits that tell a story, so keep each commit rather than squashing them
allow_auto_merge: Nothing merges without a person while there is one maintainer
description_mentions_private: The description must match the repository's visibility

private_vulnerability_reporting: SECURITY.md promises it; the GDS Way asks for a way to report security problems
secret_scanning: Free on public repositories; catches leaked credentials
secret_scanning_push_protection: Blocks a push that contains a credential
dependabot_security_updates: Fixes for known vulnerabilities arrive as pull requests

main_protected: The GDS Way: protect the main branch; require a pull request and the build check, and block force pushes and deletion

category:feature-assessment: The form in .github/DISCUSSION_TEMPLATE/feature-assessment.yml only appears in a category with this slug

required: Issue and discussion templates apply these labels, and GitHub skips a label that doesn't exist
